name: co-company-formation
description: Colombia company formation and entity choice for calendar 2026, focused on the ordinary SAS route: founders, liability, private-document authentication, asset deed exceptions, authorised/subscribed/paid capital, governance, commercial registration and current Chamber/RUES RUT and NIT procedure. Covers departmental registration-tax classes and microenterprise boundaries, annual renewal, prior-year auditor thresholds, financial statements and conditional tax handoffs. Trigger on Colombia company formation, crear SAS, Cámara de Comercio, RUT empresa, NIT, matrícula mercantil, revisor fiscal and capital SAS. Distinguishes alternative S.A./Ltda./foreign branches, bank onboarding and foreign representative facts; excludes sector licensing, investment/immigration procedures and unverified total fees or service guarantees.
